literal: face to-smile befriending friendship-is-not heart's inside to-smile befriending friendship
translation: Friendship is not befriending someone just to bring a smile to the face. True friendship is befriending them so that the heart smiles from within.
modern: முகம் மட்டும் மலரும்படி நட்பு கொள்வது உண்மையான நட்பு ஆகாது. நெஞ்சத்தின் உள்ளே மகிழ்ச்சி மலரும்படி நட்பு கொள்வதே உண்மையான நட்பு ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the depth of true friendship by contrasting outward expressions with inner feelings. The poet explains that merely smiling with the face and showing outward affection does not constitute real friendship. True friendship occurs only when the heart rejoices from within, indicating genuine love and sincere connection. The repetition of the word for smiling emphasizes the difference between superficial acquaintance and deep emotional bonds.
